01 / OVERVIEW

What I worked on.

I worked on the React Native application and its device-integration layer, including Bluetooth-connected health devices, measurement screens, device selection flows, history views, and metric presentation.

02 / CONTRIBUTION

My role
in the product.

  • +Built React Native screens for blood pressure, sleep, scale, and oximeter experiences.
  • +Integrated Bluetooth devices using react-native-ble-plx where applicable.
  • +Worked with device-specific modules and event-driven measurement flows.
  • +Implemented device selection, connection, measurement, and history UI patterns.
  • +Built metric presentation and calculated health values such as pulse pressure and MAP from available readings.
03 / TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
01

Device connectivity

The application connects to multiple health devices over Bluetooth and presents their measurements inside a unified mobile experience.

02

Real-time data

Device integrations require event-driven flows for connection state, measurement updates, and user feedback.

03

Technical depth

This project demonstrates mobile engineering beyond ordinary UI work, including BLE workflows and integration with device-specific modules.
